contract_deviations.flavour: task-text spec vs running T-005 implementation
contract_deviations.issue: Task text specified DEFAULT 's3' / 'N0' / 'pandas' on source/noise/engine and column order with recorded_at last. T-005's running defensive DDL has NOT NULL without DEFAULT and places recorded_at second. Aligned to T-005 per task instruction 'if T-005 used a slightly different name or type, align this DDL to T-005'. No behavioural impact: T-005 INSERT always supplies those three columns.
Task-text included idx_scale_runs_recorded ON scale_runs(recorded_at DESC) which T-005 did not create.
contract_deviations.resolution: kept (additive, non-conflicting). Index now exists on the live table.

contract_deviations.issue: architecture.md includes n_flights, continuity columns and only the rmse_m IS NOT NULL filter. Task-text SQL omits those two columns and adds AND wall_secs IS NOT NULL. Followed task-text exactly as written in the prompt.
contract_deviations.resolution: applied-as-task-spec; flagged for T-006 dashboard scoping. If the heatmap/table panel in dashboard 08 needs n_flights or continuity it must query fact_experiment_result directly rather than v_pareto_frontier.

test_notes: Task is pure DDL; no unit tests invoked. Idempotence of the SQL file is the correctness criterion and was verified by two back-to-back applies with exit 0.
next_action: T-006 (dashboard 08_accuracy_cost.json) is unblocked. View returns 0 rows until T-003 populates rmse_m / wall_secs non-NULL on synthetic cells; dashboard panels should degrade gracefully.
risks: View exposes 5 cols; architecture.md indicates 7. If T-006 or later consumers depend on n_flights / continuity from the view, DDL will need an amendment ADR.
Pre-T-003, v_pareto_frontier is empty; dashboard panels wired to it will render blank until synthetic cells land.
